The '''Emperor's Retreat''' was [[Emperor]] [[Darth Sidious|Palpatine's]] private retreat on the [[planet]] [[Naboo]]. Situated in the hill country west of the artists' retreat at [[Moenia]], it was a sprawling, heavily fortified complex hidden behind high walls. It overlooked a tranquil and picturesque [[lake]]. Although the baroque architecture and green-domed towers resembled the capital city of [[Theed]], it was located out in hill country. In addition to strong walls and a remote and secret location, the retreat has a number of security systems to protect the Emperor and his [[Imperial Court|court]]. With the assistance of the [[Imperial Security Bureau|ISB]], the retreat was fitted with a sophisticated security system that was run from a central security center. The system combined an extensive network of [[Holocamera|holocams]], audio pickups, and scanners to make a safety grid monitored by security technicians. A full [[stormtrooper]] [[battalion]] was garrisoned at the retreat at all times, along with [[armor]] units from the [[Imperial Army]].<ref name="NoP" /> Additionally, the [[209th Stormtrooper Division]] that was also stationed on Naboo, was in close proximity to the retreat. As such, many believed that membership in the [[division]] fast-tracked the possibility of joining the [[Emperor's Royal Guard]].<ref name="Rise">''[[Star Wars: The Rise and Fall of the Galactic Empire]]''</ref>

A sanctuary from the hustle and bustle of [[Coruscant]], the Emperor chose Naboo for his retreat because of the familiarity of his [[homeworld]] and his appreciation for sights and smells that soothed him during his [[meditation]]s. Whenever Palpatine visited, he had the usual collection of courtiers, hangers-on, Army and [[Imperial Navy's officer corps|Navy]] [[officer]]s, and high-level [[bureaucrat]]s to attend him, all jockeying for the Emperor's attention.<ref name="NoP" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Emperor's Retreat was first mentioned in the [[2016]] ''[[Star Wars: Force and Destiny]]'' sourcebook ''[[Nexus of Power]]''.<ref name="NoP" /> In the [[Star Wars Legends|''Star Wars'' Legends]] continuity, the Emperor's Retreat first appeared as a location in the massively multiplayer online [[roleplaying game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]''. It serves as the starting point for a number of interconnected quests, collectively termed the "Imperial Theme Park."<ref name="Serving">{{SonyCite|url=players/news_archive.vm?id=67382&month=082007|text=Friday Feature – Serving the Empire}}</ref>
